author: Yffe
content: Failing test at thermite-spec/tests/divergence_c10_guarded_catchall.rs::divergence_guarded_only_catchall_is_non_exhaustive demonstrates the divergence. ROOT CAUSE: check_match_exhaustiveness identifies the matched enum only via variant_pattern_name over arms; a match whose sole arm is a guarded catch-all (_ if cond) over an enum names no variant, so matched_enum is None and the function returns early with no exhaustiveness check. Per REQ-3/AC-3b a guard does NOT complete a match, so this should be NonExhaustiveMatch. Verus backstops it end-to-end (lowered match is E0004 -> forge L0), so it is NOT an L3-laundering hole, only a validator-completeness gap (opaque verus L0 instead of a structured NonExhaustiveMatch). Test is #[ignore]d (verus backstops; not a release blocker).
